tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything: the darkened screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sidebar, panels and cards one step above bg.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects and secondary buttons; hover on surface.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The current sidebar item and the selected edition's fill (with an accent edge).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, table rules, the sidebar edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and the dashed outline of things not in the library (3:1 on bg).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles on bg, surface and raised.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body copy, metadata lines, nav items.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, captions, counts.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Quiet text: hints, eyebrow labels, not-in-library titles. 4.5:1 on bg, surface and raised; not on selected.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The projector beam: main action, selected edition, progress, active nav edge. One accent per screen region.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: An edition's added scenes; 'up to date' status.

tokens.name: removed
tokens.usage: An edition's cut scenes; mistake reports; errors.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Medium confidence; conflicts that need a look.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral review states such as 'not on the Edition List'.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The left edge of the gradient that keeps text readable over a backdrop.

styles.name: title-hero
styles.usage: A title's name over its backdrop. Always upper case; 72px on phones.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The heading of a page without a backdrop.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Edition names, panel titles, stat numbers.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A minute shorter; adds Ripley finding the cocooned crew.
styles.usage: The difference line and other single key sentences.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The Nostromo answers a distress signal from a distant planet.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, card titles under artwork, nav items when current.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Upper-case kicker above a title; status chips (1px tracking).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a caption's lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side padding beside the sidebar (16px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, thumbnails in lists.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, artwork, edition rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the spotlight frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Counts and avatar buttons only.

tokens.name: shadow-art
tokens.usage: A poster sitting on a backdrop. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The left navigation, both apps.

tokens.name: ratio-scope
tokens.usage: Spotlight and hero backdrops: CinemaScope letterbox.

tokens.name: ratio-still
tokens.usage: Continue-watching and collection stills (16:9).

tokens.name: ratio-poster
tokens.usage: Posters (2:3) on grids and title pages.
